title: Konjo Plan Artifact
description: Emitted by a readonly Planner, consumed by the Executor as its system prompt, and recorded to the ledger before the Executor spawns. See KONJO_REVIEW_PIPELINE_PLAN.md section 4 Phase 1 and section 7.3/7.4. The scope field's minItems:1 constraint is load-bearing for the future router (section 2.4): a plan artifact whose scope is absent, empty, or schema-invalid must fail this schema, or the scope-escape routing rule fails open. predicted_tier is logged for prediction-vs-actual comparison only and grants no routing authority (section 7.4) -- a future router must not read it when assigning a tier.

goal.description: The task goal this plan addresses, in the Planner's own words.

scope.description: Explicit file/glob list the Executor may touch. Never representable as empty-but-valid -- see this schema's top-level description.

invariants.description: Hard constraints the Executor's diff must preserve.

test_strategy.description: How the Executor is expected to verify its own work.

non_goals.description: Explicitly out of scope for this plan, stated so the Executor does not drift into adjacent work.

predicted_tier.description: The Planner's predicted review tier. Zero routing authority (section 7.4) -- logged only, so prediction-vs-actual disagreement can be measured as a scope-fidelity signal. A future router MUST ignore this field when assigning a tier.

planner_model.description: The exact model version string that produced this plan (reproducibility, section 3.3 L23 precedent).

planner_commit.description: The repo commit SHA the Planner read against.
